name: Tasties coconut cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Invert Sugar Syrup, Raising Agents [INS 503 (ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)]. Desiccated Coconut Powder (1.8%), lodised Salt, Emulsifiers (INS 322, INS 472e), Milk Solids, Nature Identical Flavouring Substances and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Coconut, Milk, Vanilla), Dough Conditioner (INS 223).
